errors.evidence: The x-axis starts from the year 2000, not 2001.
The y-axis range goes up to 35000, not 31149. 31149 is the final data point for one of the lines, not the axis maximum.
The y-axis has major gridlines and labels at intervals of 5000, not 1000.

errors.text_span: Синята линия, означена като „БВП на един заето лице на цени на 2015 г.“
errors.evidence: The blue line represents 'БВП на един зает по текущи цени' (GDP per employed person at current prices), not 'на цени на 2015 г.' (at 2015 prices). The description swaps the labels of the two lines.
The blue line is a dashed line, not a solid ('плътна') line.
The blue line series starts in the year 2000, not 2001.
The starting value for the blue line in 2000 is 8683, not 18055. The value 18055 belongs to the orange line in the year 2002.
The value for the blue line in 2017 is 29021. The value 27777 is incorrect and does not correspond to a labeled point for the blue line in that year.
The second line in the plot is orange, not yellow.

errors.text_span: Жълтата линия, означена като „БВП на един заето лице на цени на 2015 г.“
errors.evidence: While this is the correct label for the orange line, the description previously and incorrectly assigned the same label to the blue line, creating a contradiction where both lines are described as having the same meaning.
The starting value for the orange line in 2000 is 16328, not 10573. The value 10573 belongs to the blue line in the year 2002.

errors.text_span: достига стойност 28098 на оста Y през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The value 28098 for the orange line corresponds to the year 2018, not 2017.
The description for both lines stops at 2017, omitting the final data point and value for the year 2018, which is the end of the time series shown in the chart.
